text: Bitcoin is holding firm near $78.6k with minimal decline, while Ethereum has underperformed with a 1.8% pullback, suggesting selective profit-taking in altcoins despite strong overall sentiment. The Fear & Greed Index sits at 74 in greed territory and has climbed sharply over the week, indicating sustained bullish positioning even as volume remains healthy at $123B. Bitcoin's dominance at 59.1% reflects a market favoring the largest asset, though the weakness in mid-cap alts like Ethereum signals that conviction may be concentrated rather than broadly distributed.
